primary_endpoints.algorithm_gain: 8 = 2 tasks x 2 learners x 2 comparators; average ten-round Brier(MinRisk/ParBaLS)-Brier(PA)
primary_endpoints.mechanism_interactions: 8 = 2 tasks x 2 learners x 2 contrasts: gain(high O)-gain(low O), gain(full O)-gain(empty O), on common MinRisk states at rounds2/5/8. Matched random half reported as quantity control without extra significance search.
primary_endpoints.explanation_prediction: 4 = 2 tasks x 2 learners; MAE(M4 constant)-MAE(M4 ridge) on 60 full-O common states, evaluated jointly by test-group resampling. No coefficient fit on new tasks.

delta: For each task, mean across20 seeds of .005 times D0 LR Brier on legal development set; fixed before evaluation of T. Diagnostic delta=0.
intervals: Percentile paired applicant-group bootstrap with common group weights across all learners/replays/treatments and Bonferroni tail .05/(2*20); approximate conditional inference, not guaranteed full-population coverage. Centered bootstrap p and Holm20 also reported.
independent_unit: Available entity/exact-duplicate group in one shared sealed T; not replay seed, round, or ordinary branch
scope: Conditional on fitted finite procedures and this fixed historical cohort; no training-population coverage, no actual rejected-borrower counterfactual, no strict as-of outcome timing
stopping: Run fixed40 replay tasks and complete audits once; report unresolved outcomes, no result-adaptive new seeds or lowering delta
diagnostic_extrapolation: Report out-of-M4-feature-range share; failure is retained and does not trigger changing features or ridge.
